scope: Synthetic single-queue GPU-generated procedural sidecar with candidate-stage consumer and replay. This is not the runtime, general GPU provenance, or full shader 219.
ordered_work: Copy CPU-validated synthetic 64-byte leaf records and Rust-encoded directory to GPU default memory.
Generate two conservative AABBs from GPU leaf data, transition UAV output to AS build input, build one BLAS and a transformed/masked TLAS, then dispatch the guarded candidate helper.
Read back generated AABBs and confirm that all axes strictly enclose the source triangle bounds; run ten hit/miss/edge/mask candidate checks.

After GPU fence completion, change one recorded upload and replay the same closed command list. Readback confirms regenerated bounds, disappearance of old hits and continued hit on unchanged triangle.
negative_controls: Malformed selector sets converter status 2 and leaves its sentinel output untouched; that output is not submitted to an AS build.
Short physical leaf extent sets converter status 1 and leaves the entire sentinel output untouched; that output is not submitted to an AS build.
Short private candidate-directory extent sets helper status 2 and commits no hits.
limitations: Only two validated, unpaired TRI0 records; no general leaf layout, arbitrary graph, geometry flags, RTZ behavior, ray numerical range or transforms are proven.
No runtime provider integration or guest VA association. The directory is CPU-generated for fixed fixture instances; original GPU-written guest TLAS inputs are not captured.

Valid source is controlled by the fixture. Conversion status is observed after the list runs; an invalid result could already have reached AS build in that command sequence. A real implementation must validate before dependent GPU work or provide a proven GPU-side fail-closed path.

Replay is after completion on one queue. Concurrent in-flight submissions, allocator reset, clone/compact/update, aliases, cross-queue waits, immutable generation selection and fence retirement are not verified here.
